text: This report conveys the Auditor’s Letter to Management prepared by Welch LLP, which was not available at the April Board meeting when the 2022 Audited Consolidated Financial Statements were approved.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Received the Auditor’s Letter to Management, as presented in Attachment 1 to the report (June 29, 2023) from the Director of Finance, Toronto Atmospheric Fund, for information.
